title: SquirrelPAK 123
description: A PAK that has the smell of fresh vanilla yet a hint of spicy tech and a heaping helping of adventure, tweaked for the weekend player. It's 1 2 3 Easy Squirrels!
body:
# SquirrelPAK 123

Welcome to Team SquirrelCraft's first ever PAK on NeoForage and on first pack on the newer version of Mincraft!

> tl;dr: 123 Easy Squirrels! - A 1.21.11 mod pack by Team SquirrelCraft that is aimed for the player that has limited time to play on the newest MC version

### Whats a SquirrelPAK?
Welcome to Team SquirrelCraft's first SquirrelPAK on Modrinth! If your new to SquirrelPAKs they are mod packs made for folks who don't have a lot of time to play and may short attention spans! With this in mind we try to select mods and settings that make it little easier to get started and progress quickly.

### About This PAK
SquirrelPAK 123 Easy Squirrels is our first PAK on NeoForge launcher and our first up to date Minecraft version! We have out standard mods that we can't live with out, then added quality of life mods and just a hint of tech mods! See the mod list for full list. Playing this PAK is as Easy as 1 2 3!

#### Highlighted Mods

*Not all mods listed for full list [see mod list](https://github.com/SquirrelCraft/SquirrelPAKs/blob/prod/paks/neoforge/1.21.11/SP-123/ModList.md)*

* Life Improvement/Easy Mode mods
    *  Plasmo Voice / JIE / Jade
    *  Easy Villagers, Mobs, Farming
    *  Starter Kit
    *  Fortunate Ancient Debris / Furnace Recycle
    *  Mineral Chance
*  Map Mod
    *  Xaero's Minimap/World Maps
*  Vanilla Plus Mods
	* Advanced Netherite
	* Bottled Air
	* Double Doors
	* Just Hammers
*  Builders Tools
    * Jake's Build Tools
*  Storage Mods
    *  Traveler's Backpack / Sophisticated Backpacks
    *  Sophisticated Storage / Storage Drawers
*  Tech Mods:
    *  Tom's Simple Storage
    *  Integrated Dynamics Suite
    *  Customizable Elevators
    *  Short Circuit
* Emersive Experience 
    * Entity Model Features
    * Entity Texture Features
    * Connected Glass / Realistic Bees
    * Villager Names / Death Messages
* World Gen
	* Dungeons and Taverns (All of them)
	* Towns and Towers
* Included Resource Packs
	* Dramatic Skys
	* Fresh Animations
*  Server Tools
    *  Open Parties and Claims
	*  Corps
    *  Maint Mode
